name: temporal_rollback
description: FlowFS v2 Temporal Time-Travel and atomic per-file rollback engine. Capture turn checkpoints, inspect snapshot vaults, and revert workspace file mutations atomically across conversation turns.

action.description: Action to perform: 'checkpoint' to save file snapshots, 'list' to inspect available turn checkpoints, 'rollback' to atomically restore a file or entire turn.

session.description: Conversation or session identifier (defaults to active session).

turn.description: Target turn number to create checkpoint for or restore from.

file.description: Single target file absolute path to checkpoint or restore.

files.description: List of file paths to checkpoint together.

label.description: Descriptive human-readable label for the checkpoint.

revert_turn.description: Turn number whose entire set of files should be restored.
